item.title: Singer Jonathan Junior live in the One FM Studio
item.description: One FM Breakfast announcer Plemo and announcer Josh Revens talk to the local singer Jonathan Junior who sings a number of his songs live in the One FM studio.

item.title: Maree from the Visitor Centre talks what’s on this weekend in the Goulburn Valley – 6.3.26
item.description: One FM announcer John Painter talks to Maree from the Shepparton Visitors Centre about everything that's happening in the Goulburn Valley this weekend.

item.title: Johnny Painter Interviews Bill Winters from RoadSafe Goulburn Valley – March 6, 2026
item.description: One FM announcer John Painter interviews Bill Winters from RoadSafe Goulburn Valley. Bill gives an update on everything they have been up to.

item.title: Plemo reads the weekly Livestock report – Wednesday the 11th of March, 2026
item.description: One FM breakfast announcer Plemo reads the weekly livestock report from the Shepparton saleyards.

item.title: Paul Colyvan from Australian Red Dirt duo Born n’ Bred
item.description: One FM Breakfast announcer Plemo talks to Paul Colyvan from Australian Red Dirt duo Born n' Bred. We also hear two of their tracks 'White Lies' and 'The Kelly's'.

item.title: Mooroopna Education & Activity Centre (MEAC) Manager Jan Phillips
item.description: One FM breakfast announcer Plemo interviews the Manager of the Mooroopna Education and Activity Centre (MEAC) Jan Phillips, talks about who they are and everything they do and how you can get involved.

item.title: Sam Campi on the upcoming Shepparton Italian Festa
